title: TemperPaw — Platform Overview
description: Single pane of glass for TemperPaw agent orchestration health, runtime behavior, and Temper platform metrics.

definition.content: **Runtime dashboard source of truth.** Panels use emitted Temper runtime metrics for TemperPaw service health. Retired trace-metric migration overlays are intentionally absent because they are not live/deployable for `service:temperpaw`.

**Agent Session Trace.** Open Trace Explorer with `service:temperpaw operation_name:temperpaw.agent.session @session_id:<Session ID>` or bridge fields such as `@managed_session_id:<Managed Session ID>` and `@inner_session_id:<Inner Session ID>`, then pivot from `dd.trace_id`. The root span must be `temperpaw.agent.session`; child spans should show turns, context preparation, provider auth, LLM calls, tool calls, WASM integrations, approvals, recovery, Postgres DBM calls, and terminal state.

**Logs by Trace.** Filter Log Explorer with `service:temperpaw @dd.trace_id:<trace_id>`, `@session_id:<Session ID>`, `@managed_session_id:<Managed Session ID>`, or `@inner_session_id:<Inner Session ID>`. Required facets: `dd.trace_id`, `dd.span_id`, `session_id`, `managed_session_id`, `inner_session_id`, `turn_id`, `agent_id`, `tool.name`, `gen_ai.system`, `gen_ai.request.model`, and error metadata.

**LLM Observability.** GenAI spans are routed through the collector with `dd-otlp-source: llmobs`. Search LLM Observability for `ml_app:temperpaw`, then group by `gen_ai.system`, `gen_ai.request.model`, `gen_ai.usage.input_tokens`, `gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`, `session_id`, and `tool.name` to isolate provider/model latency, retries, token usage, and failed calls.

**Postgres DBM.** Use APM > Databases with `source:postgres service:temperpaw` to inspect DBM query metrics, query samples, wait events, blocking queries, and explain plans. For a slow session, pivot from the `temperpaw.agent.session` trace to DB spans, then use DBM `query_signature`, `service`, `env`, and `dbm` views to identify slow normalized queries.

Use structured logs first for metadata failures: `service:temperpaw @observability_event:temperpaw.fs @workspace_id:<workspace id> @fs.operation:create_file @fs.path:<path>`. Blob payload logs use `@observability_event:temperpaw.blob` with `@file_id:<file id>` and `@content_hash:<sha256>`; pivot to blob wait metrics only after File/Workspace metadata succeeded.

definition.title: Monty REPL Acquisitions by Configured Cap

definition.content: Use structured logs first: `service:temperpaw @observability_event:temperpaw.sandbox @sandbox_provider:modal @sandbox_id:<sandbox id> @sandbox.operation:bash`. Host HTTP metrics cover Modal/Tensorlake bridge calls with `call_kind:text`; verify runtime config key `modal_bridge_url` when Modal requests fail before sandbox creation returns an id.

definition.content: Profiles are captured on-demand via `GET /_admin/profile/cpu?seconds=N` and `GET /_admin/profile/wall?seconds=N`. Enable with `TEMPER_PROFILING_ENABLED=true`, auto-upload with `TEMPER_PROFILING_AUTO_UPLOAD=true`. Jump to APM → Profiles for flame graphs.

definition.title: Cedar Evaluation Duration avg / max (ms fallback)
Cedar Phase Duration avg / max (ms fallback)

definition.content: ADR-0084 decomposes AuthZ latency before optimization. Enable Datadog percentile aggregations for temper_cedar_evaluation_duration, temper_cedar_evaluation_duration_ms, and temper_cedar_evaluation_phase_duration_ms before treating p95/p99 widgets or monitors as live gates. The avg/max fallback panels remain useful until that metric configuration lands.

Trace budget policy keeps canonical request roots and reduces noisy helper spans. `wasm_auxiliary` defaults to 5% and `dispatch_background` defaults to 25%. Raise `TEMPER_TRACE_WASM_AUX_SAMPLE_PCT` or `TEMPER_TRACE_DISPATCH_BACKGROUND_SAMPLE_PCT` temporarily during incidents when child-span detail matters more than trace volume.
